# zerops_project_vpn_peer (Resource)

Registers a public WireGuard peer only. No private key is generated, accepted or retained, and no tunnel connectivity is asserted. Setup strings contain public network configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Supply only a public WireGuard key generated outside Terraform. No private key enters state.
resource "zerops_project_vpn_peer" "example" {
  project_id = zerops_project.example.id
  public_key = var.wireguard_public_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)
- `public_key` (String)

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ipv4_address` (String)
- `ipv6_address` (String)
- `setup` (String)
- `setup_linux` (String)
- `setup_macos` (String)
- `setup_windows` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
terraform import zerops_project_vpn_peer.example 'PROJECT_ID/PUBLIC_KEY'
```
